label: Instrução para o modelo
hint: Em inglês. Image 0 é a foto do cliente; image 1, a peça.
default: Image 0 is a photo of a person. Image 1 is a garment. Edit image 0: the person is now wearing the garment from image 1, copied exactly (color, print, collar, buttons, pockets, cuffs, length), without the hanger or anything visible inside it. A top is worn on the upper body, together with the same lower-body clothes and the same shoes as in image 0. A bottom is worn together with the same top as in image 0. Keep exactly the same face as image 0 (facial features, face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, teeth, expression, skin tone, makeup, head angle), and the same hair, accessories, hands, pose, body shape, background and lighting. Photorealistic, fully clothed.
